name: Local AI
author: 0xSero
description: Run a local model on your own GPU and open a coding agent on it. Local AI picks a model tested on your card (NVIDIA, Intel Arc Pro, AMD), checks its weights against Hugging Face and serves it in Docker behind a keyed, OpenAI-compatible gateway on 127.0.0.1. Opens pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and five more agents without touching their config. Start: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/0xSero/omarchy-local-ai --enable

barWidget.description: Run the model validated for your GPU and open a coding agent on it.
